label: Time-Use Grid
description: Where the hours go — a different grain from both the checklist and the narrative arc, deliberately quarreling with the idea that a life is best seen through episodes.

regions.label: Morning
regions.oneLine: how your mornings unfold — the first hour, the rhythm, what sets the tone

regions.label: Work Block
regions.oneLine: the core work hours — what focus looks like, what breaks it, what sustains it

regions.label: Evening
regions.oneLine: how your evenings wind down — the border between work and rest

regions.label: Week Shape
regions.oneLine: the shape of a week — which days feel different, where the seams are

regions.label: Season Patterns
regions.oneLine: how your rhythms shift with seasons — winter and summer selves

regions.label: Lost Time
regions.oneLine: the time that disappears — what you reach the end of a day having not done
